article.title: Continuance of new domicile.
article.content: A new domicile continues until the former domicile has been resumed or another has been acquired.
article.html:
13Continuance of new domicile.

Section 13 · Part II · page 19 of the Act

A new domicile continues until the former domicile has been resumed or another has been acquired.
